title: LAMP2 drives M2 macrophage polarization and promotes glioma progression through autophagy.
snippet: Macrophages are abundant immune cells in the glioma microenvironment and are closely associated with cancer progression. Lysosome-associated membrane protein 2 (LAMP2) is a key regulator involved in the maturation of autophagolysosomes. This study employed scRNA-seq and bulk RNA-seq analyses to identify the potential role of LAMP2 in low-grade glioma (LGG)....
